scripts.build: npm run sync:data && tsc && vite build && node scripts/prerender.js
scripts.build:web: npm run sync:data && tsc && vite build
scripts.r2:put:wasm: npx --yes wrangler r2 object put synmergia-client/game.wasm --file web/game.wasm --remote --content-type application/wasm
scripts.r2:put:pck: npx --yes wrangler r2 object put synmergia-client/game.pck --file web/game.pck --remote --content-type application/octet-stream
scripts.r2:put: npm run r2:put:wasm && npm run r2:put:pck
